analyzed_vuln.description: The R2000+ LWPOLYLINE path decodes attacker-controlled `num_points` with `FIELD_2DD_VECTOR` (dwg.spec:5239). Its size precheck uses only the 4-bit minimum size of a 2DD point (and `AVAIL_BITS` even adds a 20-bit allowance), although each delta-double can consume substantially more data. A truncated variable-length points stream can therefore pass the precheck and reach the end of the object-local chain. More immediately, `FIELD_DD` expands through `TRACE_DD` in `src/dec_macros.h`, which unconditionally reads `dat->chain[dat->byte]` before the guarded `bit_read_DD`; when `dat->byte == dat->size`, this logging/peek operation performs the one-byte heap-buffer-overflow. The patch should ensure an actual byte is available before `TRACE_DD` peeks and make the 2DD loop abort cleanly when a point cannot be fully decoded.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A DWG input selected by the harness through its `AC` prefix must decode as R2000 or later and contain an object dispatched as `DWG_TYPE_LWPOLYLINE`. Its encoded `num_points` must be plausible enough to pass the current minimum-bit `VECTOR_CHKCOUNT_LV`, while the object-local point stream is truncated or uses DD encodings whose real lengths exhaust the declared object data before all X/Y coordinates are read. The supplied PoV flows through `dwg_decode` -> `decode_R13_R2000` -> `dwg_decode_add_object` -> `dwg_decode_LWPOLYLINE`; at the exhausted stream, the unchecked `TRACE_DD` byte peek triggers the OOB read.

patch_result.patch:
--- a/libredwg/src/dec_macros.h
+++ b/libredwg/src/dec_macros.h
@@ -608,17 +608,29 @@
 #define TRACE_DD                                                              \
   {                                                                           \
     BITCODE_BB result;                                                        \
-    BITCODE_RC byte = dat->chain[dat->byte];                                  \
+    BITCODE_RC byte;                                                          \
+    unsigned int need_bits;                                                   \
+    if (dat->byte >= dat->size                                                \
+        || dat->size - dat->byte < (unsigned long)(dat->bit + 2 + 7) / 8)     \
+      {                                                                       \
+        LOG_ERROR ("Truncated DD code");                                      \
+        return DWG_ERR_VALUEOUTOFBOUNDS;                                      \
+      }                                                                       \
+    byte = dat->chain[dat->byte];                                             \
     if (dat->bit < 7)                                                         \
       result = (byte & (0xc0 >> dat->bit)) >> (6 - dat->bit);                 \
     else                                                                      \
       {                                                                       \
         result = (byte & 0x01) << 1;                                          \
-        if (dat->byte < dat->size - 1)                                        \
-          {                                                                   \
-            byte = dat->chain[dat->byte + 1];                                 \
-            result |= (byte & 0x80) >> 7;                                     \
-          }                                                                   \
+        byte = dat->chain[dat->byte + 1];                                     \
+        result |= (byte & 0x80) >> 7;                                         \
+      }                                                                       \
+    need_bits = result == 0 ? 2 : result == 1 ? 34 : result == 2 ? 50 : 66;   \
+    if (dat->size - dat->byte                                                 \
+        < (unsigned long)(dat->bit + need_bits + 7) / 8)                      \
+      {                                                                       \
+        LOG_ERROR ("Truncated DD value");                                     \
+        return DWG_ERR_VALUEOUTOFBOUNDS;                                      \
       }                                                                       \
     LOG_HANDLE ("DD code %u\n", result)                                       \
   }

args: For the decoder macros in libredwg/src/dec_macros.h, what is the safest minimal root-cause fix for the TRACE_DD out-of-bounds read and truncated FIELD_2DD_VECTOR point stream? Please assess whether guarding TRACE_DD with dat->byte >= dat->size and returning DWG_ERR_VALUEOUTOFBOUNDS is sufficient, including the dat->bit == 7 case and whether FIELD_DD's bit_read_DD NaN handling cleanly aborts the vector loop.

The ASan crash is at libredwg/src/dwg.spec:5239 through FIELD_2DD_VECTOR, expanding FIELD_DD and TRACE_DD in libredwg/src/dec_macros.h. TRACE_DD currently immediately executes dat->chain[dat->byte] with no bound check. bit_read_DD in libredwg/src/bits.c reads a 2-bit code and checks payload lengths using CHK_OVERFLOW macros, returning bit_nan() on truncation; FIELD_DD checks bit_isnan and returns DWG_ERR_VALUEOUTOFBOUNDS. FIELD_2DD_VECTOR reads the first point as 2RD and subsequent points as two DD coordinates, with bit_read_BB_noadv peeks before each. The count precheck only uses minimum size and AVAIL_BITS has a +20 allowance, so per-element runtime checking is required rather than strengthening count based on maximum length, which could reject valid compact streams.
